proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13952 haḍḍa gives Punjabi haḍḍī, western hāḍ and the addendum’s hāṛko/hāḍkī/hāḍgu bone forms. This supports Gojri aḍḍi with initial h-loss and Nimadi hāḍkā; it does not equate unexplained final clusters or suffixes automatically.
